concerns.text: T004 is tagged [P] and the execution-order note claims "T003/T004 depend on nothing but their own files," but T004's verification explicitly "drives a real edit through the structured-harness /edit endpoint via TestClient" — that endpoint is produced by T003. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency hidden under a parallel-safe tag; either T004 must be sequenced after T003, or its verification must be reworded to use a logger-level fixture independent of the interface endpoints.

T008 is marked "VERIFIED — preserve as-is," but its input artifact (SemanticValidation records) is being rebuilt in T005/T007 with new per-trial semantics (records including failures, one per trial). The task list should note T008 must be re-verified against the new validation-record format once T007 lands; "preserve as-is" understates a real downstream dependency on a changing producer.

T001 makes run_pipeline.py runnable end-to-end, but the steps it orchestrates (curation, simulation, validation, analysis, report) are implemented in T002–T009. As ordered, T001's verification ("--smoke completes with exit 0") cannot pass until later tasks exist. Either T001 should be scoped to the harness/scaffolding only (wall-clock guard, progress printing, CLI flags) with end-to-end completion verified in T011, or it should be moved after T009.
